# Data Import

## étudiants + entrées + diplomes par cantons (su-b-15.02.04-he-02.xlsx)

```{r import}
# Load data
# fichier étudiants + entrées + diplomes par cantons 
# Packages
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(janitor)


library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

# Chemin du fichier
path <- file.path(input_raw_dir, "su-b-15.02.04-he-02.xlsx")


# Packages
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)

# Fichier
xlsx_path <- path

# Feuilles à parcourir (tous les cantons + Étranger)
skip <- c("tpl", "Hinweise_Remarques", "Total")
sheets <- setdiff(excel_sheets(xlsx_path), skip)

# Normalisation des noms d’unités (BS, BE, ..., FS-CH, ETHZ, TH-Chur, TOTAL)
std_unit <- function(x){
  x |>
    str_replace_all("\\s+", "") |>
    str_replace_all("FS[- ]?CH", "FS-CH") |>
    str_replace_all("TH[- ]?Chur", "TH-Chur") |>
    toupper() |>
    str_replace("^TH-CHUR$", "TH-Chur")
}

# Lecture d'un bloc fixe (plage donnée) pour une feuille
read_block_fixed <- function(path, sheet, range, metric){
  raw <- read_excel(path, sheet = sheet, range = range, col_names = FALSE, col_types = "text")

  # 1re ligne = en-têtes ; B6 est vide -> devient le libellé de domaine
  hdr <- as.character(unlist(raw[1, ], use.names = FALSE))
  units <- std_unit(hdr[-1])                # colonnes d'unités (BS...TOTAL)
  dat <- raw[-1, , drop = FALSE]            # données sans la ligne d'en-tête
  colnames(dat) <- c("domaine", units)      # noms propres

  # conversion numérique et passage en long
  dat |>
    mutate(across(-domaine, ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_replace(.x, "\\s", ""))))) |>
    pivot_longer(cols = -domaine, names_to = "unite", values_to = "valeur") |>
    mutate(
      region = ifelse(sheet == "Ausland-Étranger", "Étranger", sheet),
      metric = metric
    ) |>
    select(region, metric, domaine, unite, valeur)
}

# Ranges fixes
ranges <- list(
  etudiants = "B6:R14",
  entrants  = "B19:R27",
  diplomes  = "B32:R40"
)

# Boucle principale : toutes les feuilles x 3 blocs
df_final <- map_dfr(
  sheets,
  ~ bind_rows(
      read_block_fixed(xlsx_path, .x, ranges$etudiants, "etudiants_automne"),
      read_block_fixed(xlsx_path, .x, ranges$entrants,  "entrants_automne"),
      read_block_fixed(xlsx_path, .x, ranges$diplomes,  "diplomes")
    )
) |>
  arrange(region, metric, domaine, unite)

# Aperçu
print(df_final, n = 50)
```

## Etudiants et entrées par cantons et par districts, série temporelle - (su-b-15.02.04-he-01.xlsx)

```{r}

# Packages
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)

# Fichier
xlsx_path <- file.path(input_raw_dir, "su-b-15.02.04-he-01.xlsx")

# Packages
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)



# Feuilles à parcourir (tous les cantons)
skip <- c("tpl", "Hinweise_Remarques", "Total")
sheets <- setdiff(excel_sheets(xlsx_path), skip)

# ---- helpers tolérants ----
find_header_row <- function(df_chr){
  # cherche la ligne contenant "Bezirk/District" (casse/espaces tolérés)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_chr))) {
    row_vals <- df_chr[i, , drop = FALSE] |> unlist(use.names = FALSE)
    row_vals <- stringr::str_squish(trimws(as.character(row_vals)))
    if (any(stringr::str_detect(row_vals, regex("^Bezirk\\s*/\\s*District$", ignore_case = TRUE)),
            na.rm = TRUE)) return(i)
  }
  NA_integer_
}

find_total_row <- function(df_chr, start_row){
  # cherche "Total Kanton/Canton" dans la colonne B (ou n'importe où si besoin)
  # on accepte variantes "Total Kanton", "Total Canton"
  pat <- regex("^Total\\s+(Kanton|Canton)(/Canton)?", ignore_case = TRUE)
  # d'abord col B
  for (i in seq.int(start_row + 1L, nrow(df_chr))) {
    val <- as.character(df_chr[i, 2, drop = TRUE])
    if (!is.na(val) && str_detect(str_squish(val), pat)) return(i)
  }
  # fallback: n'importe quelle colonne
  for (i in seq.int(start_row + 1L, nrow(df_chr))) {
    row_vals <- df_chr[i, , drop = FALSE] |> unlist(use.names = FALSE)
    row_vals <- str_squish(as.character(row_vals))
    if (any(str_detect(row_vals, pat), na.rm = TRUE)) return(i)
  }
  NA_integer_
}

# tibble vide mais typé (pour éviter les erreurs d'arrange)
empty_out <- function(){
  tibble(
    region = character(),
    district = character(),
    bev_pop_total = numeric(),
    stu_et_total = numeric(),
    permille_total = numeric(),
    bev_pop_h = numeric(),
    stu_et_h = numeric(),
    permille_h = numeric(),
    pct_h = numeric(),
    bev_pop_f = numeric(),
    stu_et_f = numeric(),
    permille_f = numeric(),
    pct_f = numeric()
  )
}

# Lecture d'une feuille
read_districts_one_sheet <- function(path, sheet){
  raw <- readxl::read_excel(path, sheet = sheet, col_names = FALSE, col_types = "text")
  # détection
  header_row <- find_header_row(raw)
  if (is.na(header_row)) return(empty_out())

  total_row  <- find_total_row(raw, header_row)
  if (is.na(total_row) || total_row <= header_row + 1L) return(empty_out())

  # plage B:M (données sous l'en-tête jusqu'à la ligne "Total")
  rng <- sprintf("B%d:M%d", header_row + 1L, total_row)
  dat <- suppressMessages(readxl::read_excel(path, sheet = sheet, range = rng,
                                             col_names = FALSE, col_types = "text"))

  # on s'assure d'avoir 12 colonnes (B..M), sinon on complète/recadre
  if (ncol(dat) < 12) {
    dat <- dplyr::bind_cols(dat, as_tibble(matrix(NA_character_, nrow(dat), 12 - ncol(dat))))
  } else if (ncol(dat) > 12) {
    dat <- dat[, 1:12, drop = FALSE]
  }

  names(dat) <- c(
    "district_raw",
    "bev_pop_total", "stu_et_total", "permille_total",
    "bev_pop_h",    "stu_et_h",     "permille_h",
    "pct_h",
    "bev_pop_f",    "stu_et_f",     "permille_f",
    "pct_f"
  )

  out <- dat |>
    # retirer la ligne "Total Kanton/Canton"
    filter(!str_detect(str_squish(coalesce(district_raw, "")),
                       regex("^Total\\s+(Kanton|Canton)(/Canton)?", ignore_case = TRUE))) |>
    mutate(
      district = district_raw |>
        str_replace("^Bezirk\\s+", "") |>
        str_replace("^District\\s+", "") |>
        str_squish(),
      across(c(bev_pop_total, stu_et_total, permille_total,
               bev_pop_h,    stu_et_h,    permille_h, pct_h,
               bev_pop_f,    stu_et_f,    permille_f, pct_f),
             ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_replace(.x, "\\s", "")))),
      region = sheet
    ) |>
    select(region, district,
           bev_pop_total, stu_et_total, permille_total,
           bev_pop_h, stu_et_h, permille_h, pct_h,
           bev_pop_f, stu_et_f, permille_f, pct_f)

  out
}

# ---- Exécution sur toutes les feuilles ----
df_districts <- purrr::map_dfr(sheets, ~ read_districts_one_sheet(xlsx_path, .x)) |>
  mutate(region = if_else(region == "Ausland-Étranger", "Étranger", region)) |>
  arrange(region, district)

# Résultat
print(df_districts, n = 50)

# (optionnel) long format :
# df_long <- df_districts |>
#   pivot_longer(-c(region, district), names_to = "mesure", values_to = "valeur")

```

```{r}
# Requete des niveaux géographiques
get_geolevel <- function(date1){
  url <- str_c("https://sms.bfs.admin.ch/WcfBFSSpecificService.svc/AnonymousRest/communes/levels?startPeriod=",date1,"&endPeriod=",date1,"&useBfsCode=false&labelLanguages=fr&format=csv")
  result <- read_csv(url)
}

spatial_index <- get_geolevel("11-11-2025")
```

## Etudiants et entrées série temporelle

```{r}

# Packages
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)

xlsx_path <- file.path(input_raw_dir, "su-b-15.02.04-he-01.xlsx")


# Feuilles cantonales
skip   <- c("tpl", "Hinweise_Remarques", "Total")
sheets <- setdiff(excel_sheets(xlsx_path), skip)

# utilitaire: coupe les colonnes entièrement vides à droite
trim_right <- function(df){
  keep <- colSums(!is.na(df)) > 0
  if (!any(keep)) return(df[, 0, drop = FALSE])
  df[, seq_len(max(which(keep))), drop = FALSE]
}

# choisit la 1re ou 2e ligne comme entête (celle qui a le plus d'années valides)
pick_header_idx <- function(df, kind = c("HS","ENT")){
  kind <- match.arg(kind)
  pat  <- if (kind == "HS") "^(20\\d{2})\\s*/\\s*(\\d{2})$" else "^(20\\d{2})$"
  score <- function(v) sum(str_detect(str_squish(as.character(v)), regex(pat)), na.rm = TRUE)
  s1 <- score(df[1, , drop = TRUE])
  s2 <- if (nrow(df) >= 2) score(df[2, , drop = TRUE]) else 0
  if (s2 > s1) 2L else 1L
}

# lit une plage fixe et renvoie un long format
read_block <- function(sheet, range, metric, kind){
  x <- suppressMessages(read_excel(xlsx_path, sheet = sheet, range = range,
                                   col_names = FALSE, col_types = "text"))
  if (nrow(x) < 2) return(tibble())

  x <- trim_right(as.data.frame(x, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  if (ncol(x) == 0) return(tibble())

  # 1) détecter la ligne d'entête (1 ou 2)
  hidx <- pick_header_idx(x, kind)

  # 2) récupérer toutes les étiquettes d'entête et filtrer:
  #    - non vides
  #    - qui ressemblent à des années
  hdr_all <- str_squish(as.character(unlist(x[hidx, ], use.names = FALSE)))
  if (kind == "HS") {
    keep <- str_detect(hdr_all, "^(20\\d{2})\\s*/\\s*(\\d{2})$")
  } else {
    keep <- str_detect(hdr_all, "^(20\\d{2})$")
  }
  keep[is.na(keep)] <- FALSE
  # enlève aussi explicitement les vides/NA
  keep <- keep & !is.na(hdr_all) & hdr_all != ""
  if (!any(keep)) return(tibble())     # aucune année valable

  hdr <- hdr_all[keep]                 # années propres
  # 3) sous-ensemble: colonnes gardées + 3 lignes sous l'entête
  start <- hidx + 1L
  end   <- min(nrow(x), start + 2L)    # M, F, Total
  dat   <- x[start:end, keep, drop = FALSE]
  if (ncol(dat) == 0 || nrow(dat) == 0) return(tibble())

  # 4) poser des NOMS EXPLICITES (clé du bug)
  colnames(dat) <- hdr

  # 5) convertir -> long
  sex_vec <- c("M","F","Total")[seq_len(nrow(dat))]
  dat_num <- as_tibble(lapply(dat, function(col)
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_replace(col, "\\s", "")))))
  dat_num$sex <- sex_vec

  out <- dat_num |>
    relocate(sex) |>
    pivot_longer(-sex, names_to = "year_label", values_to = "value") |>
    mutate(
      metric = metric,
      year = if (kind == "HS") {
        m <- str_match(year_label, "^(20\\d{2})\\s*/\\s*(\\d{2})$")
        as.integer(ifelse(!is.na(m[,2]), paste0(substr(m[,2], 1, 2), m[,3]), NA))
      } else {
        suppressWarnings(as.integer(year_label))
      },
      region = sheet
    ) |>
    select(region, metric, sex, year, value) |>
    filter(!is.na(year))
}

# extraction sur toutes les feuilles, plages FIXES demandées
df_time <- map_dfr(
  sheets,
  ~ bind_rows(
      read_block(.x, "B5:L9",   metric = "etudiants_HS", kind = "HS"),
      read_block(.x, "B14:L17",  metric = "entrants",     kind = "ENT")
    )
) |>
  mutate(region = if_else(region == "Ausland-Étranger", "Étranger", region)) |>
  arrange(region, metric, sex, year)

print(df_time, n = 60)
```
